body.text:
Wow... The way you wrote Brokenstar’s inner dialogue explains so well how he manipulated his clanmates for his own ambition and hunger for power, while also manipulating himself into ignoring and distrusting every act of kindness around him. It makes so much sense that he would come to see force and fear as the only real way to earn respect, and insist that what he did was the sole right path.

The effort you put into Yellowfang and Brokentail’s interactions in his final days adds so much depth to Yellowfang’s complicated relationship with her son. Especially, the canon-divergent ending struck me as more emotionally powerful than canon. “This is more than I deserve from you,” Apart from coming to terms with his fate out of, what you said, "captain's integrity", he's also somehow accepting her as his mother and feeling gratitude for her final care, and was there even a bit regret of what he had done to her?

Great work! Kudo attached~

out.construct: Besides X, he also Y（除了……之外，还……）

why.label: Besides
why.note: besides 表示在前面的内容之外再加一点，不是排除。用 apart from 会让读者以为接受命运和接纳母亲互相对立，而你想说的是“另外还有”。

why.label: as you put it
why.note: 英文里要把引号里的话挂到作者身上，读者才知道 “captain’s integrity” 是作品里的说法，而不是你自己的概括。直接用 what you said 这类插入语读起来很生硬。

why.label: grateful
why.note: 用形容词 grateful 代替 feel gratitude 这种名词结构，口语里更自然。feels grateful for 比 feeling gratitude for 更像评论区的说法。

why.label: I’m surprised by that
why.note: somehow 容易被读成怀疑“他不可能接纳”。直接说 surprised 就清楚表明你是惊讶、好奇，并不是不信。

why.label: I’d love to know how he gets there
why.note: 原句想问他怎么会走到这一步，用 I’d love to know 把好奇说出来，比把问题硬塞进长句里更像读者在聊天。

why.label: regret for
why.note: regret 后面接 for 表示为某件事后悔，regret of 不成立。写成 for what he did to her 后，读者才知道悔的是对母亲做过的事。

out.plan: 保留原文的全部观点，但把“接受命运”和“接纳母亲”放进同一句，用表示“除了……之外”的那个词引出第一点，再用“还”接上第二点，两点是补充关系，不是对立。提问“有没有悔意”单独成句，引语后面直接点明出处。
out.example: [Besides] fixing the bike, Tom [also] cleaned the garage [and] [feels] tired now.

body.q: 为什么不能保留我原来的说法？

out.answer: 原句有几处会让英文读者误解：apart from 表示排除，后面却接 also 补充，读者会以为“接受命运”和“接纳母亲”是对立的；somehow 读起来像在怀疑他不会接纳母亲；regret of 不成立；what you said 挂得突兀，读者分不清 captain's integrity 是谁的话。参考版本只改这些地方，你的观点、疑问和语气都保留了，比如 Besides accepting his fate as “captain’s integrity,” as you put it, he also accepts her as his mother... 这样读者一看就知道两件事是并列的，引号里的话也是作者说的。
